verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair privacy question for a SaaS connectivity platform that stores logs and tailnet data, so the axis applies. The evidence pack has nothing on retention periods, log retention settings, or data deletion. User removal (docs-13) and ephemeral nodes (docs-39) are adjacent features, not data-retention controls, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
